skills.name: lock_screen
skills.description: Lock the screen or computer session.

skills.name: take_screenshot
skills.description: Capture a screenshot of the entire screen or active window.

region.description: Screen region to capture: full screen or active window.

skills.name: manage_window
skills.description: Manage the active window: fullscreen, close, minimize, float, center, or maximize.

skills.name: system_power
skills.description: Put the computer to sleep or hibernate.

action.description: Power state action: sleep or hibernate.

skills.name: toggle_wifi
skills.description: Turn Wi-Fi on, turn Wi-Fi off, or check Wi-Fi connection status.

action.description: Wi-Fi action: on, off, or status.

skills.name: toggle_bluetooth
skills.description: Turn Bluetooth on, turn Bluetooth off, or check Bluetooth status.

action.description: Bluetooth action: on, off, or status.

skills.name: read_clipboard
skills.description: Read text content currently in the system clipboard.

skills.name: write_clipboard
skills.description: Copy text content to the system clipboard.

content.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

skills.name: type_text
skills.description: Type text into the currently active/focused window. Supports multi-line blocks via clipboard paste.

text.description: Text to type into the focused application.

skills.name: press_key
skills.description: Press a keyboard key or key combination with modifiers (e.g. Return, Escape, Tab, Super+Return, Ctrl+C).

key.description: Key name, e.g. Return, Escape, BackSpace, Tab, Space, a, Down, Up.

modifiers.description: Optional modifier keys, e.g. super, ctrl, alt, shift, or combinations like ctrl+alt.

skills.name: list_desktop_commands
skills.description: List installed Omarchy desktop commands and keybindings. Supports fuzzy search query.

query.description: Optional search query to filter keybinding titles or shortcut keys.

limit.description: Maximum number of command entries to return (default 25).

skills.name: execute_desktop_command
skills.description: Execute an Omarchy desktop command or keybinding by title (e.g. Terminal, Close window, Browser, Omarchy menu).

title.description: Exact or fuzzy title of the Omarchy command/keybinding to execute.

skills.name: list_bar_panels
skills.description: Discover all installed top-bar shell plugins, icons, and popups.

skills.name: open_bar_panel
skills.description: Summon and open a top-bar settings panel by plugin ID (e.g. omarchy.bluetooth, dejan94.todos, omarchy.audio, omarchy.network).

panel_id.description: Plugin ID from list_bar_panels, e.g. omarchy.audio or dejan94.todos.

skills.name: close_bar_panel
skills.description: Dismiss and close an open top-bar panel by plugin ID.

skills.name: set_volume
skills.description: Set master speaker output volume to an exact percentage (0 to 100).

skills.name: control_microphone
skills.description: Mute, unmute, or toggle default microphone mute state.

action.description: Microphone action: mute, unmute, or toggle.

skills.name: set_brightness
skills.description: Set display brightness to an exact percentage (1 to 100).

skills.name: move_window_to_workspace
skills.description: Move the currently focused window to a specified desktop workspace number.
